build_kimi_k25_model: build a Kimi-K2.5 conditional generation model with vision and video-chunk multimodal support
create_processing_info: create KimiK25ProcessingInfo to resolve media token IDs and configure the image processor
build_dummy_inputs: build dummy inputs for Kimi-K2.5 model profiling with configurable image dimensions
process_multimodal_inputs: process multimodal image and video-chunk inputs with prompt replacement for the Kimi-K2.5 model
load_model_weights: load weights into the Kimi-K2.5 model using AutoWeightsLoader with HF-to-vLLM weight mapping
